messages:
amy (AE): Hey team — Orion agreed to a 7-day sandbox POC. They want a hosted API key for generation only, IP-restricted to two addresses, and automatic revocation after 7 days. Can we fast-track?

 tom (SE): Yep. Need exact IPs, region preference, and whether embeddings are needed. Also confirm token delivery method (portal vs email).

 amy (AE): IPs: 18.194.22.10/32, 3.5.12.9/32. Region: eu-west. No embeddings. Use portal one-time secret reveal. Need key by tomorrow morning.

 lydia (Security): Conditions: IP allowlist mandatory, TTL <= 7 days, audit logging ON, and rate limit at 15 qps for safety. No wildcard CIDRs. If any customer PII flows, escalate.

 vik (DevEx): I can create an ephemeral key with expires_at and allowed_ips. I'll enable audit_log and attach metadata (poc:orion, contact:procurement@orion.example.com). Rotation plan: create key with 7-day TTL and schedule revoke at expiry; also create a backup key 1 hour before expiry if needed.

 tom (SE): For rotation, prefer issuing a fresh key and phasing in by switching the client to the new secret via the one-time portal. That avoids breaking integrations.

 vik (DevEx): Agreed. Creation command I'll run (admin token required):

 ```
 curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/admin/keys \
   -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
   -d '{"label":"orion-sandbox-2026-06","scopes":["generate.text"],"allowed_ips":["18.194.22.10/32","3.5.12.9/32"],"expires_at":"2026-06-10T12:00:00Z","audit_log":true,"rate_limit_qps":15}'
 ```

 vik (DevEx): I'll create it now, post key_id (no secret) and trigger the portal reveal for procurement. I'll also schedule a revoke job at expiry.

 key-bot: key_provisioned: {"key_id":"key-orion-9f2d","label":"orion-sandbox-2026-06","expires_at":"2026-06-10T12:00:00Z","allowed_ips":["18.194.22.10/32","3.5.12.9/32"]} (secret withheld)

 lydia (Security): Looks good. Please export the audit logs to security for the duration of the POC.

 amy (AE): Sending onboarding + portal link to Orion now. Closing when revoke job completes. :white_check_mark:
